//: Shared compiler options. Every package extends this file and adds only its rootDir,
outDir and include — which is what makes 'the same TypeScript everywhere' a fact
rather than eighteen manifests that happen to agree today.
Packages resolve each other through their own `exports`: workspace symlinks make them
ordinary dependencies, so a `paths` list would be a second truth about the same thing.
The engine is a NODE tool, so there is no DOM lib and no `jsx`. A check reads files,
spawns processes and returns a verdict; anything reaching for a browser global here is
a mistake the type system should make immediately.
